capabilities: Render chord notation inside fenced code blocks marked as song or lyrics
Display chord diagrams for stringed instruments such as guitar
Support chords in any Western scale or mode, including extended jazz chords
extras: Full chord syntax documentation lives in the markdown-it-chords demo, not in this README. The plugin currently only processes fenced code blocks; the author may later add formatting for all text and plans to submit it to the community plugin store.
intentEvidence: This is a very barebones adaptation of markdown-it-chords as an Obsidian plugin.
problem: Obsidian has no native Markdown syntax for writing chord notation and chord diagrams alongside lyrics.

relations.evidence: This is a very barebones adaptation of markdown-it-chords as an Obsidian plugin.
You can add this to your Obsidian install using the BRAT community plugin.

summary: Markdown processor that renders musical chord notation and chord diagrams for stringed instruments inside fenced song or lyrics code blocks.
